scenarios.prompt: A single-period stocking decision. We sell a product for $80, buy it for $25, and can liquidate unsold units for $8. Daily demand is normally distributed with mean 200 and sd 50. How many units should I order today? Report optimal_quantity, critical_ratio, z_star.

Bakery ordering problem. Fresh bread sells for $12, costs $9 to bake, and unsold loaves go to waste at end of day (salvage $0). Daily demand mean 500, sd 120. How many loaves should I bake? Report optimal_quantity, critical_ratio, z_star.
A luxury item sells for $200, costs us $30, salvage value $15. Demand mean 100, sd 25. How many to stock? Report optimal_quantity, critical_ratio, z_star.
